Vercel Labs creates tools and experiments for developers.We release projects early,learn from how people use them,and keep investing in the ones that prove useful.

Classifications

Each project is classified by its current stage, so you know what’s actively maintained, what’s still taking shape, and what’s no longer in development.

  • Labs products Projects that have proven useful over time. Maintained, built to be relied on, and distinct from Vercel’s core products.
  • Active experiments Projects we are building and learning from right now. Expect fast iteration, rough edges, and breaking changes.
  • Past experiments Projects no longer in development. Some became products, some folded into existing ones, and some showed us what to build next.

Labs products

  • agent-browser

    Browser automation CLI for AI agents

    vercel-labs/agent-browser

  • deepsec

    Security harness run by coding agents

    vercel-labs/deepsec

  • just-bash

    Bash for Agents

    vercel-labs/just-bash

  • json-render

    The Generative UI framework

    vercel-labs/json-render

  • skills

    The CLI for the open agent skills ecosystem

    vercel-labs/skills

  • portless

    Named local URLs instead of ports

    vercel-labs/portless

  • fx

    Unix like coding agent

    vercel-labs/fx

  • vgpu

    Modular cross-runtime WebGPU library

    vercel-labs/vgpu

Active experiments

  • scriptc

    TypeScript-to-Native Compiler

    vercel-labs/scriptc

  • wterm

    A terminal emulator for the web

    vercel-labs/wterm

  • emulate

    Local API emulation for CI and sandboxes

    vercel-labs/emulate

  • Native SDK

    Toolkit for building native desktop apps

    vercel-labs/native

  • CallScript

    Code Mode, without the sandbox

    vercel-labs/callscript

  • run

    A secure alternative to eval for agents

    vercel-labs/run

  • visual-json

    The schema-aware Visual JSON Editor

    vercel-labs/visual-json

  • Zerolang

    The Programming Language for Agents

    vercel-labs/zerolang

  • phase

    Lifecycle-aware UI performance layer

    vercel-labs/phase

  • webreel

    Record scripted browser demos as video

    vercel-labs/webreel

  • opensrc

    npm package source for coding agents

    vercel-labs/opensrc

Past experiments

  • autoship

    Release workflows now handled directly by coding agents

    vercel-labs/autoship

  • vercel-open

    Core functionality now built into the Vercel CLI

    vercel-labs/vercel-open

  • next-skills

    Skills and guidance now maintained within Next.js

    vercel-labs/next-skills

  • ralph-loop-agent

    Long-running agent loops now handled by modern harnesses

    vercel-labs/ralph-loop-agent
